items.title: Awesome Selfhosted
items.content_text:
### Software / Analytics

*   [d8a.tech](https://d8a.tech) - A data collection service that works with your existing Google Analytics setup to capture user activity and send it straight to your own private database. ([Demo](https://lookerstudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/0e4102b6-c38b-4f55-aa25-c1fe91d1c1e9), [Source Code (⭐10)](https://github.com/d8a-tech/d8a)) `MIT` `Go/Docker`
*   [HitKeep](https://hitkeep.com/) - Privacy-first web analytics with goals, funnels, ecommerce tracking, and team management in a single binary with embedded DuckDB (alternative to Google Analytics, Plausible, Umami). ([Source Code (⭐46)](https://github.com/pascalebeier/hitkeep)) `MIT` `Go/Docker`

### Software / Document Management - E-books

*   [Inkheart](https://gitlab.com/Nystik/inkheart) - Lightweight PDF library and reader. `Apache-2.0` `Docker`
*   [kiwix-serve (⭐852)](https://github.com/kiwix/kiwix-tools) - HTTP daemon for serving wikis from ZIM files. `GPL-3.0` `C++`

### Software / File Transfer - Single-click & Drag-n-drop Upload

*   [PicoShare (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/mtlynch/picoshare) - Minimalist, easy-to-host service for sharing images and other files. `AGPL-3.0` `Go/Docker`

### Software / Games

*   [Red Eclipse 2](https://www.redeclipse.net/) - Arena first-person shooter similar to Unreal Tournament. ([Source Code (⭐509)](https://github.com/redeclipse/base)) `Zlib/MIT/CC-BY-SA-4.0` `C/C++/deb`

### Software / Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI)

*   [LLMKube](https://llmkube.com) - Kubernetes operator for llama.cpp-native LLM inference with GPU scheduling, Apple Silicon Metal support, and OpenAI-compatible API. ([Source Code (⭐67)](https://github.com/defilantech/LLMKube)) `Apache-2.0` `Go/Docker/K8S`

### Software / Task Management & To-do Lists

*   [Super Productivity](https://super-productivity.com) - Advanced todo list app with integrated timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. Integrates with Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Redmine and OpenProject. ([Source Code (⭐19k)](https://github.com/super-productivity/super-productivity)) `MIT` `Docker`
